title: TCS New York City Marathon — The Start
claims: Wave and corral assignments appear on the official race bib; runners may move to a later or slower wave or corral but not to an earlier or faster one.
Corrals open and close on a published schedule before each wave start; the finish time is the net time from when the runner crosses the start line.
The start village has more than 1,600 toilets; only the clear official start-village bag is allowed into Fort Wadsworth, and bags are inspected.
